title: Canonical spectrum test objects of an inverse module tower
statement: Work over $S=\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z$ with schemes [def-pc-scheme], affine spectra and their contravariant morphisms [def-weil-affine-spectrum], algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space], and the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use inverse sequences [def-weil-inverse-system] and the category of scheme test objects $\operatorname{ProperQuotTest}(B)$ over an algebraic space $B$ [def-sfb-space-proper-quot-functor]. For every commutative ring $R$, let $\operatorname{inverseModuleSpec}(R)$ be $\operatorname{Spec}R$ equipped with its unique structural map to $S$; for a ring map $a:R\to R'$, let $\operatorname{inverseModuleSpecMap}(a)$ be $\operatorname{Spec}(a):\operatorname{Spec}R'\to\operatorname{Spec}R$, as a morphism over $S$. Given rings $A_n$ indexed by $n\in\mathbf N$, maps $r_n:A_{n+1}\to A_n$, and a cone $c$ on this inverse sequence, write $L$ for its vertex and $\pi_n:L\to A_n$ for its components. Define $\operatorname{inverseModuleTest}(c,n)$ to be the scheme test object $\operatorname{Spec}A_n\to\operatorname{Spec}L$ given by $\operatorname{Spec}(\pi_n)$, viewed by Yoneda as a test object over the algebraic space represented by $\operatorname{Spec}L$. The cone equation $r_n\circ\pi_{n+1}=\pi_n$ gives the commuting triangle $\operatorname{Spec}(r_n):\operatorname{inverseModuleTest}(c,n)\to\operatorname{inverseModuleTest}(c,n+1)$ over $\operatorname{Spec}L$; this is $\operatorname{inverseModuleTestMap}(c,n)$, with triangle equality $\operatorname{inverseModuleTestMap\_w}$. These definitions apply to every cone, without assuming it is limiting or that transition maps are surjective. In Situation 0CX4, $c$ is the specified limit cone and Lean index $n$ denotes paper level $n+1$.
